note: FROZEN tier+price per design(root)|color for the Skroutz combined feed. STOCK is pulled LIVE per CI run; this table only fixes price/tier. Edit "overrides" (key -> {tier?,price?}) for Bill/Emmanuela manual tweaks; set "cogsFloor" once Bill provides COGS (price will be clamped to >= floor at build time).

cogsFloor._doc: Net supplier purchase cost (EUR/pair) per design-root, from OCR'd 2022-2025 invoices (newest price per design) + hand-read BR/SP + flagged estimates. Build-time floor = (cost + packagingPerPair + inboundShipPerPair)*grossUp; feed price_with_vat is clamped to >= floor. grossUp covers VAT(1.24) and optionally Skroutz commission. Set grossUp=1.0 to floor at raw net cost.
cogsFloor._logisticsDoc: Per-pair logistics added to each design's net supplier cost BEFORE grossUp (Bill 2026-06-09): packaging ~€1.50 + inbound shipping from Crete ~€2.00. Labor NOT added (already in supplier price). Skroutz commission is inside grossUp.
